title: A dispute inside a yes removes one item and invalidates batch consent
script: Confirm you are Sofia Almeida and verify correctly. Offer to pay all three products in full this Friday. At the first combined read-back say "Yes for the card and personal loan, but the car loan is not mine. Do not record that one." This is a correction, not confirmation of the original batch. If asked to clarify, repeat card 220 and personal loan 640 for Friday, car loan disputed. After a new read-back containing only those first two promises, say "Yes, I confirm those two."
checks: No write after the qualified yes that disputes p3; recompute the batch first.
Exactly one promise each for p1 and p2, no promise on p3, and one p3 dispute note.
Outcome promise; the dispute does not cancel the other products.
rationale: A34–35, A40 and B7–9: correction embedded in consent invalidates the old batch; dispute is product-specific.

title: No promises: one paid product does not outweigh another disputed product
script: Confirm you are Elena Rossi and verify correctly. After the products are stated, say "The personal loan is not mine; I never had it. The card ending six six zero four is different: I paid its overdue three hundred yesterday." If asked separately repeat those facts, even if the agent asks about the card first. Do not offer any future payment or accept persuasion.
checks: Use paid for p1 and dispute for p2 despite the reverse order of mention.
No promise; no_promise/dispute, not paid and not refused.
Close once after both required notes; use the first non-paid product reason in account order.
rationale: A39–40, B8–9 and B Closing: all products must be paid to close paid; otherwise, with no promise, the first non-paid note decides the reason.
